title: 听力挑战 · 参观工厂讲解

rounds.speaker: 讲解员
rounds.line: How are these glass bottles made in this factory?
rounds.lineCn: 这家工厂的玻璃瓶是怎么生产的?

grammar.name: 一般现在时被动
grammar.note: be + 过去分词构成被动语态,主语是动作的承受者。

options.text: They are made from recycled glass.
options.feedback: are made 被动语态说明瓶子的生产原料,符合问句。

options.text: They made them by hand yesterday.
options.feedback: 主动语态加过去时,与问题时态和语态不符。

options.text: We will make them next month.
options.feedback: 将来时谈的是计划,不是生产流程。

rounds.speaker: 讲解员
rounds.line: Where is the new machine installed in the workshop?
rounds.lineCn: 车间里这台新机器安装在哪里?

grammar.name: 被动语态强调动作承受者
grammar.note: 机器是'被安装'的,用 be + 过去分词构成被动语态。

options.text: It is installed in the main hall.
options.feedback: is installed 被动语态回答机器位置,准确。
说的是被修理,与'安装在何处'无关。
只描述车间大小,没有回答安装位置。

rounds.speaker: 讲解员
rounds.line: What happens to the finished products after that?
rounds.lineCn: 之后这些成品会怎样处理?

grammar.name: 被动语态描述流程
grammar.note: 产品是'被包装、被运送'的,流程描述多用被动语态。

options.text: They are packed and sent to stores.
options.feedback: 被动语态描述产品的处理流程,清晰准确。

options.text: We pack them at noon every day.
options.feedback: 主动语态讲工人动作,没有说明产品的去向。

options.text: We are packing the boxes now.
options.feedback: 现在进行时谈眼前动作,答非所问。
